review_evidence: README identifies Statlib as a Lean formalization project for probability and statistics.

The 24 current-primary Lean files cover e-values/e-variables, inference and QMD plus substantial ForMathlib convex/order/ENNReal/EReal/measure-theoretic integration infrastructure and tutorial-manual Lean sources.
Package configuration is lakefile.toml and therefore not current-primary; no primary file was established to be content-lossless build/generated material.
summary: Retain the complete current-primary Statlib probability/statistics, supporting measure theory and tutorial Lean corpus; no safe hard exclusion was established.
